solutionNarrative: Fog and Cable cars made me think of a city, but not yet with total confidence. Ghirardelli Square and Alcatraz Island pushed the puzzle toward northern California, though the board still felt like a broad travel collage at first.

lessons.title: City boards often mix different kinds of clues

lessons.title: One iconic landmark can name the whole city
